parsed.name: SocketCAN 守护进程总线接口
parsed.description: 这是一个非物理的软件通信组件，用于通过 socketcand 服务连接和操作 CAN 总线。它主要用于实验系统中的 CAN 消息发送与连接关闭，不直接代表某一台具体仪器。
parsed.description_en: This is a non-physical software communication component used to connect to and operate a CAN bus through the socketcand service. It is mainly used in lab systems for CAN message transmission and connection shutdown, rather than representing a specific physical instrument.

actions.description: 向 CAN 总线发送一条消息。
actions.description_en: Transmit a message to the CAN bus.

actions.description: 停止所有活动的周期任务并关闭连接套接字。
actions.description_en: Stop all active periodic tasks and close the socket connection.
